segments.summary: Exact review confirmed the provider-neutral guard, blocklist, authenticated override, GUI configuration, and additive local-pattern contracts. Adversarial review found no deterministic invalid-regex, file-I/O, or atomic reload failure policy.

Exact review confirmed canonical event authority, payload, user diagnostics, and test coverage. Adversarial review found ambiguity in approved-override behavior on event-write failure and in command-preview privacy lifecycle.

Exact review confirmed locked checklist authority, Rust module lineage, runner integration, settings, and event mapping. Adversarial review found remote mounted-project identity trust and failure transitions unspecified.

Exact review confirmed FileSafe primacy and owner boundaries across orchestrator, hooks, permissions, YOLO, and accelerated search. Adversarial review found the YOLO visible-state requirement insufficiently bound to effective runtime state or falsifiable GUI criteria.

Exact review confirmed canonical path resolution, backup, atomic replacement, CAS, conflict, and append boundaries. Adversarial review found missing parent-directory durability and race-safe janitor semantics.

Exact review confirmed snapshot isolation, subprocess integrity, shared filesystem normalization, bounded records, and owner limits. Adversarial review found the probe-failure fallback unsafe on case-insensitive filesystems and rebuild limits unspecified.

Exact review confirmed packet replacement, pre-spawn dispatch gates, child clamping, and adjacent owner inputs. Adversarial review found no required revalidation transition for changing parent, credential, cache, signature, or listener state.

Exact review confirmed SecurityFilter defaults, additive overrides, prompt threat scope, attachment tokens, and compiled-prompt checking. Adversarial review found lossy path conversion and provider attachment escaping/round-trip behavior undefined.
